# Kinakaze default: ssh -p 2222 root@127.0.0.1 (password: kinakaze)
Port 2222
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ecdsa_key
PidFile /run/sshd.pid
PermitRootLogin yes
PasswordAuthentication yes
PermitEmptyPasswords no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
UsePAM no
StrictModes yes
UseDNS no
PrintMotd no
AcceptEnv LANG LC_*
Subsystem sftp internal-sftp

# Start the bundled sshd when opening the default login shell.
ENABLED=yes

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
[ ! -r /etc/default/kinakaze-sshd ] || . /etc/default/kinakaze-sshd
[ "${ENABLED:-yes}" = yes ] || exit 0
umask 077
mkdir -p /run/sshd
chmod 755 /run/sshd
exec /usr/bin/flock -n -F /run/kinakaze-sshd.lock /bin/sh -ec '
    /usr/bin/ssh-keygen -A
    /usr/sbin/sshd -t
    exec /usr/sbin/sshd -D -e
'

# In a systemd session, ssh.service owns the listener.
if [ ! -d /run/systemd/system ] && [ -x /usr/sbin/sshd ] && [ -x /usr/local/sbin/kinakaze-sshd ] && [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then
    /usr/local/sbin/kinakaze-sshd </dev/null >>/var/log/sshd.log 2>&1 &
fi

# Default services for the hosted Debian session.
enable kinakaze.target
enable ssh.service
enable dbus.socket
disable *

[Unit]
Description=Kinakaze Debian services
# Runtime initialization is performed by the Windows host.
DefaultDependencies=no
AllowIsolate=yes

[Install]
Alias=default.target

[Unit]
# The host initializes mounts and devices before starting PID 1.
DefaultDependencies=no

[Install]
WantedBy=kinakaze.target

[Unit]
# Socket activation starts the system bus when a client needs it.
DefaultDependencies=no

[Unit]
# The host initializes mounts, devices and networking before starting PID 1.
DefaultDependencies=no

[Service]
ExecStartPre=
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -A
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/sshd -t
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/sshd -D -e $SSHD_OPTS
StandardOutput=append:/var/log/sshd.log
StandardError=append:/var/log/sshd.log

[Install]
WantedBy=
WantedBy=kinakaze.target

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
# Allow service helpers to publish mounts within this guest namespace.
/bin/mount --make-rshared /
# Initialize distribution accounts and identity before PID 1 starts services.
/bin/systemd-sysusers
/bin/systemd-machine-id-setup
exec /lib/systemd/systemd --system --unit=kinakaze.target --log-target=console "$@"

[Unit]
Description=Kinakaze persistent terminal sessions
DefaultDependencies=no
ConditionPathExists=/etc/kinakaze/session.json
Before=kinakaze.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /usr/lib/kinakaze/session.py /etc/kinakaze/session.json
KillMode=process
TimeoutStopSec=5
StandardOutput=append:/var/log/kinakaze-session.log
StandardError=append:/var/log/kinakaze-session.log

[Install]
WantedBy=kinakaze.target
